paper: APPSC Group-I Services Prelims (Screening Test) 2019, Notification No. 27/2018, Paper-II General Aptitude (GS/1G/101, Series A), Part B only (Science & Technology; Current Events), held 26-05-2019

questions.s: The National Chemical Laboratory has developed a nanogenerator that could produce electric power when pressure is applied. Which of the following principles or technology is used in this ?
questions.x: Some materials produce an electric charge when they are mechanically stressed, which is the piezoelectric effect. A nanogenerator that makes power from applied pressure uses this principle.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is the new instrument developed by NASA that could search for signatures of life on Mars?
questions.x: BILI (Bio-Indicator Lidar Instrument) is a NASA-developed instrument designed to detect organic biosignatures in dust from a distance on Mars. Juno is a Jupiter probe.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s:
Common salt besides being used in kitchen can also be used as the raw material for making the following :
(i) Washing soda
(ii) Bleaching powder
(iii) Baking soda
(iv) Slaked lime
Codes :
questions.x: APPSC deleted this question in the final key. Common salt is a raw material for washing soda, baking soda and bleaching powder (through chlorine), so no single code fitted.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Magnification produced by a rear view mirror fitted in vehicles
o: can be more than or less than one depending upon the position of the object in front of it
questions.x: Rear-view mirrors are convex mirrors, which always form virtual, erect and smaller images. So the magnification is always less than one.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following phenomena of light are involved in the formation of a rainbow ?
o: Refraction, dispersion and total internal reflection
Dispersion, scattering and total internal reflection
questions.x: Sunlight is refracted and dispersed on entering a raindrop, reflected internally at the back of the drop, and refracted again on leaving. The final key accepts "refraction, dispersion and internal reflection".
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following was the first digital wallet company in India ?
questions.x: The final key gives MobiKwik, founded in 2009, as India's first digital wallet company.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: 'OneerTM' is a/an
o: Innovative technology for "Drinking Water Disinfection System"
questions.x: Oneer is a low-cost drinking water disinfection system developed by CSIR-IITR, Lucknow, and launched in 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is a "Fire and Forget" anti-tank missile ?
questions.x: Nag is DRDO's third-generation "fire and forget" anti-tank guided missile. Trishul and Akash are surface-to-air missiles, and Agni is a ballistic missile.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: IPv4 and IPv6 are addresses used to identify computers on the Internet.
o: Number of bits required for IPv4 address is more than number of bits required for IPv6 address
Number of bits required for IPv4 address is same as number of bits required for IPv6 address
Number of bits required for IPv4 address is less than number of bits required for IPv6 address
Number of bits required for IPv4 address is 64
questions.x: An IPv4 address has 32 bits and an IPv6 address has 128 bits, so IPv4 needs fewer bits.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The first computer virus is known as
questions.x: Creeper (1971), an experimental self-replicating program on ARPANET, is generally called the first computer virus. Elk Cloner (1982) was the first to spread in the wild on personal computers.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The use of mobile and wireless applications (e.g., SMS, apps, wearable devices, remote sensing and use of social media, such as Facebook, Twitter and Instagram) for health related purposes describes ______ .
questions.x: Mobile health (m-health) is the use of mobile and wireless technologies, such as SMS, apps and wearables, for health purposes.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is the full form of Li-Fi network ?
questions.x: Li-Fi stands for Light Fidelity, wireless data transmission using visible light from LEDs.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: MoU was signed between ISRO's Telemetry Tracking Command Network and which other organisations on August 6, 2017 ?
questions.x: The final key gives "All of the above" for the MoU signed by ISRO Telemetry, Tracking and Command Network (ISTRAC) on 6 August 2017.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Where will NASA send its next-generation atomic clock in 2019 ?
questions.x: NASA's Deep Space Atomic Clock was launched into Earth orbit in June 2019 to test precise navigation for future deep-space missions.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: ScatSat is for
questions.x: ISRO's ScatSat-1 (2016) carries a scatterometer that measures ocean surface winds for weather forecasting and cyclone tracking.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What was the Chandrayaan I ?
questions.x: Chandrayaan-1 (2008) was India's first lunar probe. It orbited the Moon and helped confirm water molecules there.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: ISRO opened its 1st visitor's gallery to watch rocket launches at Andhra Pradesh's Sriharikota. Its capacity is
questions.x: The launch view gallery that ISRO opened at Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota, in 2019 seats about 5,000 people.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is 'Varunastra'?
o: A mechanism devised to cause artificial rain
questions.x: Varunastra is a heavyweight anti-submarine torpedo developed by DRDO's Naval Science and Technological Laboratory in Visakhapatnam.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Jagadish Chandra Bose Centre for Advanced Technology was established with the help of
questions.x: The Jagadish Chandra Bose Centre for Advanced Technology was set up at Jadavpur University, Kolkata, with DRDO's support for defence research.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following DRDO's missile is used to destroy enemy radars and communication facilities ?
questions.x: Anti-radiation missiles home in on the radio emissions of enemy radars and communication sites. DRDO's example is the NGARM (Rudram).
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which materials are used for Superheater tubes ?
questions.x: Boiler superheater tubes are made of chromium-molybdenum alloy steels, which keep their strength and resist creep at high temperature and pressure.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which is the first State in India to make roof-top rainwater harvesting compulsory for all the houses?
questions.x: In 2001 Tamil Nadu became the first State to make rooftop rainwater harvesting compulsory for all buildings.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: How is Asthma caused in human beings ?
questions.x: Asthma is a chronic inflammation of the airways. Of the options, airborne pollutants and allergens are the ones that trigger and worsen it.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Two biodiversity hot-spots in India are
questions.x: India's biodiversity hotspots are the Himalaya (mainly the Eastern Himalayas), the Western Ghats-Sri Lanka, Indo-Burma and Sundaland. Of the pairs given, only Eastern Himalayas and Western Ghats are both hotspots.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The Statue of Liberty is green because of
questions.x: The statue has a copper skin that has weathered into a green patina of copper carbonate and sulphate compounds.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: A device used to measure the amount of moisture in the atmosphere is called a
questions.x: A hygrometer measures atmospheric humidity. A hydrometer measures liquid density, an anemometer measures wind speed and a barometer measures air pressure.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The noble gas used for the treatment of cancer is
questions.x: Radon is radioactive, and it was used in radiotherapy, for example in radon seeds, to treat cancer.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The Earth's atmosphere is divided into layers based on the vertical profile of
questions.x: The troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere and thermosphere are defined by how temperature changes with height.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The broad, green part of the leaf is called
questions.x: The flat green expanded part of a leaf is the lamina or leaf blade. The petiole is the stalk that joins it to the stem.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The disease "Itai Itai" is caused by
questions.x: Itai-itai disease, first seen in Japan, is caused by chronic cadmium poisoning, which leads to painful bone softening and kidney damage.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: MERA India has been launched to eliminate malaria from India by which year ?
questions.x: ICMR launched the Malaria Elimination Research Alliance (MERA) India in 2019 to support the goal of eliminating malaria from India by 2030.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Divyansh Singh Panwar, who secured 2020 Tokyo Olympic Quota, is associated with which field ?
questions.x: Divyansh Singh Panwar is a 10 m air rifle shooter. He won an Olympic quota by taking silver at the 2019 ISSF World Cup in Beijing.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Where is the headquarters of Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) located ?
questions.x: CSIR-Centre for Cellular and Molecular Biology is in Hyderabad.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The world's tallest 131 ft indoor waterfall has opened in which of the following countries ?
questions.x: The 40-metre (131 ft) Rain Vortex at Jewel Changi Airport, Singapore, opened in April 2019 as the world's tallest indoor waterfall.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) has established a new academic position in honor of which Indian-born philosopher and economist ?
questions.x: In 2019 LSE created the Amartya Sen Chair in Inequality Studies in honour of the Nobel laureate economist and philosopher.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which State Government has reduced the tenure of Lokayukta from eight years to five years ?
questions.x: In 2019 Rajasthan amended its Lokayukta law to cut the Lokayukta's term from eight years to five.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: According to Forbes billionaire list 2019, who is the world's wealthiest person ?
questions.x: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos topped the Forbes 2019 billionaires list with about 131 billion dollars, ahead of Bill Gates.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who has been appointed as the head of the mediation panel on Ayodhya's Ram Janmabhoomi – Babri Masjid land dispute case ?
questions.x: In March 2019 the Supreme Court named a three-member mediation panel headed by retired judge F.M.I. Kalifulla, with Sri Sri Ravi Shankar and Sriram Panchu as members.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Indian archaeologists recently unearthed a rare life-sized stucco sculpture from a Buddhist site in
questions.x: In 2019 archaeologists found a rare life-sized stucco Buddha sculpture at the Phanigiri Buddhist site in Suryapet district, Telangana.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which is the correct descending order of rice producing States in India ?
o: West Bengal, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh
Andhra Pradesh, Punjab, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh
Punjab, West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh
West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Andhra Pradesh
questions.x: In the production figures of that time, West Bengal led rice output, followed by Uttar Pradesh, Punjab and Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following statements is not correct ?
o: India is the second largest producer of fruits in the world.
India is the biggest producer of vegetables in the world.
Production of fruits, vegetables and spices is called horticulture.
Uttar Pradesh is the largest producer of wheat in India.
questions.x: China is the world's largest producer of vegetables and India is second, so that statement is not correct. India is also second in fruits, and Uttar Pradesh leads in wheat.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The Global Business Summit 2019 was held in
questions.x: The Economic Times Global Business Summit 2019 was held in New Delhi in February 2019 and was addressed by the Prime Minister.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which committee of UNSC designated Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammad Chief Masood Azhar as a global terrorist ?
questions.x: On 1 May 2019 the UN Security Council's 1267 (ISIL and Al-Qaida) Sanctions Committee listed Masood Azhar as a global terrorist, after China lifted its hold.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The Supreme Court of India has removed C.B.I Director Ranjit Sinha from
questions.x: In November 2014 the Supreme Court told CBI Director Ranjit Sinha to recuse himself from the 2G spectrum case investigation after allegations of his meetings with accused persons.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The last captive white tiger named Bajirao died recently at
questions.x: Bajirao, India's oldest captive white tiger, died in 2019 at the tiger safari of Sanjay Gandhi National Park, Mumbai.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s:
Different names of cyclones and places affected are given below. Match the following :
a. Cyclone Ockhi — I. Andhra Pradesh
b. Cyclone Gaja — II. Kerala
c. Cyclone Luban — III. Somalia
d. Cyclone Titli — IV. Arabian Peninsula
a b c d
questions.x: APPSC deleted this question in the final key. Ockhi hit Kerala and Tamil Nadu, Gaja hit Tamil Nadu (not Somalia), Luban hit Yemen and Oman, and Titli hit Andhra Pradesh and Odisha, so no code was fully correct.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: According to a recent research study, Global warming can wipe out two times more ocean-dwelling species than land and dwelling species from habitats. This study was conducted by
questions.x: A 2019 study led by Rutgers University (published in Nature) found that ocean species are lost from their habitats about twice as often as land species as the climate warms.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: To provide reservations to economically weaker sections, the Lok Sabha has passed the following amendment bill.
questions.x: The Constitution (124th Amendment) Bill, 2019 gave 10% reservation to economically weaker sections. It became the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The Union Cabinet has approved amendment to the POCSO Act recently. What is the full form of the POCSO ?
o: Protection of Cows from Social Offences
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences
Protection of Children from Social Offences
questions.x: POCSO is the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012. Amendments in 2019 brought stricter punishments, including the death penalty for aggravated assault.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: On the occasion of World Press Freedom Day, the UNESCO conferred World Press Freedom Prize 2019 awarded to two Myanmar journalists, who reported on alleged human rights violations in Myanmar. They are
o: Kyaw Soe Oo and Wa Lone
questions.x: Reuters journalists Wa Lone and Kyaw Soe Oo, jailed for reporting on the Rohingya killings, received the UNESCO/Guillermo Cano World Press Freedom Prize 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: A science teacher Peter Tabichi has won the prestigious Global Teacher Prize 2019, which honours the world's best teacher. He belongs to
questions.x: Peter Tabichi, a Franciscan friar who teaches maths and physics in a rural school in Kenya, won the Varkey Foundation's Global Teacher Prize 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The Asian Competitiveness Institute (ACI) has released the Ease of Doing Business Rankings for Indian States. Identify the States in descending order :
questions.x: In the 2019 ranking by the Asia Competitiveness Institute (National University of Singapore), Andhra Pradesh came first, Maharashtra second and Delhi third.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Andhra Pradesh has topped Ease of Living Index Rankings under AMRUT in 2018. It was followed by
questions.x: In the 2018 State ranking under AMRUT, Andhra Pradesh came first, followed by Odisha and Madhya Pradesh.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report (TDR) 2017, one of the following statements is not correct :
o: The world economy in 2017 is picking up but not lifting off.
The global growth is expected to reach 2.6%, well below pre 2008 financial crisis average of 3.2%.
At current levels of growth, both India and China will not serve as "growth poles" for global economy in near future.
India and China at their current levels of growth, they will become "growth poles" for global economy in near future.
questions.x: TDR 2017 said the world economy was picking up but not lifting off, with growth of about 2.6% against the pre-crisis average of 3.2%. It said China and India were not yet able to act as global growth poles, so the statement that they will become growth poles is not correct.

questions.s: Union Government has constituted a six member committee to look at selling as many as 149 State-owned gas and oil fields. The committee will be headed by
questions.x: In 2019 the government set up a six-member committee under NITI Aayog Vice-Chairman Rajiv Kumar to look at selling 149 small oil and gas fields of ONGC and Oil India to private firms.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who is the winner of United Nations Human Rights Prize 2018, in the field of activities for the rights of Women and Girls
questions.x: The 2018 UN Human Rights Prize went to Rebeca Gyumi, Asma Jahangir (posthumously), Joenia Wapichana and Front Line Defenders. The final key accepts any of options 1, 2 and 3; only Malala Yousafzai is wrong.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: How many Municipal Corporations are there in Andhra Pradesh ?
questions.x: The final key gives 16 municipal corporations in Andhra Pradesh at the time of the exam.

questions.s: Who is the first IPS and ITBP woman officer to successfully conquer the South Pole ?
questions.x: Aparna Kumar, an IPS officer serving as DIG in the ITBP, reached the South Pole in January 2019. She was the first woman IPS officer to do so.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Prana Raksha web application has been developed by the Chittoor Police. The app has been designed
o: To save the lives of road accident victims and reach out to women in distress.
To control the sandalwood smugglers and arrest them.
To provide better guidance and protection to pilgrims who are visiting Tirumala.
Any citizen can use this app for any purpose.
questions.x: The Chittoor district police's Prana Raksha app was meant to get help quickly to road accident victims and to women in distress.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who has taken charge as the first Chief Justice of Andhra Pradesh in Vijayawada ?
questions.x: When the separate High Court of Andhra Pradesh began functioning on 1 January 2019, Justice C. Praveen Kumar was sworn in at Vijayawada as its first (acting) Chief Justice. The final key gives him.
